requirement: aero_filewrite returns an AeroDatabase instance
rationale: Defines the structured output contract for the entire pipeline

requirement: aero_filewrite raises ValueError (message contains empty) for an empty result list
rationale: An empty list is always a caller error; silent NaN-filled tables are harder to diagnose

requirement: AeroDatabase.date is a non-empty string
rationale: Provenance field lets users identify when a table was generated

requirement: Reference quantities (Sref, Cref, Bref, Xref, Yref, Zref) are read from the first result
rationale: Carries reference geometry from the .st file through to the aero database without a separate geometry argument

requirement: A StabTable is created for every name in COEF_NAMES
rationale: All standard 6-DOF coefficients must be queryable even if some were absent from some runs

requirement: A CtrlTable is created for every (coef, surface) pair keyed as <coef>_<d_idx>_<ctrl_name>
rationale: Each control surface independently affects every coefficient; the compound key prevents collisions

requirement: Alpha breakpoints are sorted in ascending order
rationale: Monotonic axes are required by scipy RegularGridInterpolator and MATLAB lookup-table blocks

requirement: Beta breakpoints are sorted in ascending order
rationale: Monotonic axes are required by scipy RegularGridInterpolator and MATLAB lookup-table blocks

requirement: StabTable.data shape is (n_alpha x n_beta)
rationale: Correct shape is required for 2-D table indexing and interpolation

requirement: Neutral-control results (all deflections ≈ 0) populate StabTable at the correct (alpha, beta) cell
rationale: Off-neutral data must not enter the neutral aero map; populating only on zero-deflection runs enforces this

requirement: Off-neutral results do not overwrite StabTable cells
rationale: Ensures the neutral map is uncontaminated even when neutral and deflected runs share the same breakpoint

requirement: CtrlTable.data shape is (n_alpha x n_beta x n_defl)
rationale: Correct shape is required for 3-D lookup table blocks and RegularGridInterpolator

requirement: CtrlTable defl breakpoints are sorted in ascending order
rationale: Monotonic defl axis is required for 3-D interpolation routines

requirement: CtrlTable cell values match source StResult.data values
rationale: Ensures no silent truncation or reordering during pivot from list to 3-D array

requirement: CtrlTable.surface is <d_idx>_<ctrl_name> and CtrlTable.ctrl_name is the surface name
rationale: Metadata fields are used for axis labels and export struct field names

requirement: Geometry with no control surfaces produces an empty ctrl dict
rationale: ctrl must not contain phantom entries for non-existent surfaces

requirement: Geometry with no control surfaces still fills StabTable
rationale: Stability-only models are valid and must produce a complete neutral aero map

requirement: A coefficient absent from a result's .data produces NaN at that table cell
rationale: NaN distinguishes a genuinely missing value from a coefficient that happens to be zero

requirement: StabTable.data shape is (n_alpha × 1) and values are correct with multiple alpha breakpoints
rationale: Multi-alpha tables must not collapse rows or reorder values during pivot from list to 2-D array

requirement: AeroDatabase.stab_deriv contains all 30 stability-derivative keys (CLa through Cnr) as StabTable objects
rationale: All linearised stability derivatives must be accessible for analysis and plotting — missing keys would silently skip derivatives

requirement: stab_deriv table values match the fixture data at the correct (alpha beta) index
rationale: Validates that the extraction loop maps AVL derivative keys to the right array cell without off-by-one or key collision

requirement: stab_deriv tables are NaN for off-neutral runs
rationale: Stability derivatives are computed at neutral control; mixing in deflected values would corrupt the linearisation

requirement: AeroDatabase.ctrl_deriv contains one StabTable per (coef surface) pair with keys in {coef}_{d_idx}_{ctrl_name} format
rationale: Control derivatives must be keyed consistently so plots and downstream code can look them up without guessing the format

requirement: ctrl_deriv table values match the fixture CLd01 and Cld02 values at the correct array cell
rationale: Validates that CTRL_DERIV_COEFS × d_idx indexing maps to the correct AVL key without transposition or coef confusion

requirement: ctrl_deriv tables are NaN for off-neutral runs
rationale: Control derivatives are linearised at the neutral condition; deflected runs must not corrupt the derivative baseline

requirement: A case with two or more surfaces deflected simultaneously (as combinatorial-mode sweeps produce) does not overwrite an independent-mode case's value in total_ctrl, and its own deflection combination is not written to total_ctrl at all
rationale: total_ctrl is a 3-D (alpha
column5: defl) table per surface and has no well-defined cell for a case where multiple surfaces are deflected at once; silently pivoting it in would corrupt or overwrite independent-mode data

requirement: Combinatorial-style rows (multiple non-zero deflections in one case) remain fully present in results_to_dataframe
rationale: Excluding a row from total_ctrl must not lose the underlying AVL data; it stays available via the raw per-case DataFrame/CSV/JSON output

requirement: The shared all-neutral case (every control surface at 0.0) still populates every surface's total_ctrl table
rationale: The all-neutral case trivially satisfies the single-surface-active guard and must remain the common reference point across every surface's ctrl table
